messages:
Carla: Heads-up, product wants a crisp launch checklist for Dedicated reserved pools. Specifically: smoothing semantics, quota accounting, preemption behaviour, and a clear customer-facing SLA matrix. Who can own?

Ben: Ian draft. Quick Q: should smoothing be tenant-configurable or only via contract tier?

Derek: Tenant-configurable with contract guardrails. Implementation: per-tenant token-bucket + global emergency throttle. Token refill scales with commit tier.

Elaine: Agree. Need to document latency SLO differences: hard reserve vs soft smoothing (e.g., p99 target delta in ms). Legal needs to sign off on any SLA wording.

Carla: Core items I want in the checklist: (a) forced-preempt action and session-grace definition, (b) metrics and observability endpoints, (c) billing model for smoothing credits, (d) contract toggle behavior and default.

Ben: Draft checklist (quick):

- load-tests: run sustained 3k qps + spike tests 10x for 60s
- telemetry: per-tenant p95/p99, error-rate, cold-starts, token-bucket-level
- autoscale: predictive-prewarm enabled; smoothing_window=300s; guaranteed_replicas=2; eviction_grace=30s
- fallback: automatic fallback to quantized_low_mem model variant when capacity constrained
- billing: smoothing_credit_ledger + invoice_preview for customers
- contract: soft_by_default flag with opt-out to hard_reserved_lane

Derek: Small tweak: call it guaranteed_replicas (not min) and spell out eviction_grace_sec so clients can handle reconnects. Also require trace spans around token acquisition so we can measure impact.

Elaine: Recommendation on default: default to soft smoothing; enterprise customers can opt into strict hard reservations. That reduces cold capacity cost for most customers.

Ben: For canary gating: pick 3 customers with varying profiles (steady batch, low-latency chatty, bursty analytics). Canary pass criteria: no P50/P95 regression, no >1% error increase, billing preview matches expected smoothing discounts.

InfraBot: Note: staging will require temporary 2x capacity for blue/green flips. Estimated extra infra window: 36-48h. Also rolling deploy must preserve token-bucket state or smoothing semantics break during release.

Carla: Add migration/rollback runbook to checklist.

Derek: Autoscale policy decision: ML-predictive prewarm + deterministic smoothing ramp (5min), with immediate fallback to the quantized variant. That keeps tail latency controlled. We should also support manual override for ops.

Elaine: Action items: Ben to post full checklist doc today, Derek to add tracing/eviction details, Infra to provide infra cost estimate and staging plan. Launch gating: successful load tests, stable SLOs, billing preview validated, legal & sales signoff on contract defaults.

Ben: I'll draft and link load-test dashboards in #product. @Derek @InfraBot please add their pieces.

Carla: Thx. We'll review in Monday sync and set a tentative launch week. :thumbsup:

Ben: Example PromQL for token tracking: `sum by(tenant) (token_bucket_tokens{job=\"dedicated\"})` 
We need a derived panel for token consumption rate.

Derek: I'll instrument a tracing span named `smoothing.token.acquire` and a metric `smoothing.tokens_consumed_total` so we can attribute latency.

InfraBot: Cost ETA: 24h. Provisioning window noted.

Carla: Great. Closing loop 
Ben: will share doc EOD."
